title: Zippily Sessions: your CRM questions, answered
address:
Level 1/435 Khyber Pass Road
Newmarket, Auckland
shortDescription: A relaxed two-hour morning workshop for a small group of HubSpot users. Bring the thing that's been bugging you.

children.text: We're running our first Zippily Session — a free two-hour morning workshop for a small group of HubSpot users. The idea is simple: a relaxed, open conversation where you can ask questions, talk through challenges you've been dealing with, and pick up a few things you might not know HubSpot can do.
We're keeping it to five people so there's room for a real conversation rather than a room full of strangers half listening. Coffee and morning tea are on us.

whatToExpect.heading: Bring your actual portal
whatToExpect.body: We'll look at real setups on the day — yours, if you want a second opinion on something.

whatToExpect.heading: Ask the awkward questions
whatToExpect.body: The ones you didn't want to raise on a sales call. Nothing's too basic.

whatToExpect.heading: Leave with a shortlist
whatToExpect.body: Two or three things worth fixing first, in priority order.

hostIntro: Runs the sessions, answers the questions, and makes the coffee.
